mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate reached 4.65% in March 2023
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100k over two consecutive months indicates weakening labor market momentum, reducing corporate hiring and wage pressures, which leads to lower earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 100k in two consecutive months
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS rose by 155,569k in March 2023, but trend is weakening
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in residential investment (HOUST) below 1.4 million units signals weakening housing demand, which reduces construction activity and consumer wealth effects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent drop in industrial production below 101.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, reducing corporate output and profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST fell to 1,399.0 and RSAFS dropped to 665,071 in March 2023
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST < 1400.0 and RSAFS < 670,000, or the interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% while the federal funds rate remains below 4.0% signals a persistent disinflationary gap, prompting market expectations of future rate cuts, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:CPIAUCSL was 301.821 (≈3.5% YoY) in March 2023, FEDFUNDS at 4.65%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 690,000 million dollars, combined with rising industrial production, signals strong aggregate demand and corporate revenue growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS was 691,671 in March 2023, INDPRO at 103.0258
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS > 690,000 and INDPRO > 102.0, or the interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 155,000 signals a tight labor market with strong hiring, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE was 3.5% and PAYEMS was 155,569 in March 2023
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03).
